integrity: Pointwise index and ideal structure are attributed to their published discoverers. New assertions are finite index-tail counts, the harmonic scaling/volume law, and ideal-height distribution. Finite exact checks supplement but do not replace infinite proofs. Publication priority is not exhaustively certified.
scientific_limitations: Uniformity means counting nonzero nilpotents in the integer model or normalized Euclidean coordinate volume in the real model. The zero/idempotent sheet has zero three-dimensional volume. The height-zero ideal is excluded from conditional-volume formulas. No uniqueness among possible probability models is claimed.
title: Harmonic nilpotency tails and ideal-height laws for interval-translation inverse monoids
